realModel.routing: public request evidence resolves renamed session, fresh read, one synthetic queued follow-up, truthful queued response

evidence.backend: 49 focused tests pass: source auth, original receipt reconciliation, observation-only collector, durable WAV custody and routing

architecture: Stored public evidence and FTS retrieval; bounded native head reads instead of history stuffing.
Read-only background collection: no model turns, worker wakes, execution mutation or UI subscriptions.
Original device/source/recording authority retained; unresolved delivery is never blindly repeated.
Live account WebRTC transcription and speech reuse the existing account; no API-key fallback.
limits: Physical handset microphone acoustics, hardware volume keys, playback and notification rendering are not newly verified.
Provider and model timings are separate actual journeys, not a claimed full physical round trip.
Prepared workstation and Mac gateways require controlled cutover; Android update is not yet published.
Requested rich notification tooling is recorded follow-up, not implemented in this version.
